approach.summary: Forward raw webhook values through an injected Transformer with ordered observer callbacks.
rules: Delegate the unchanged input exactly once and return the original result and error.
Call Started before Transform when the observer is non-nil; call Finished only on success.
Do not normalize, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values.

title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
